summary: Revised the single evidence file per the follow-up requirements, replacing the prior full-buffer decoder with a row-scoped `_decode_row(bytes, row)` that validates the row index against CONSTRUCTION_CAPACITY, checks total observed length against independently measured (var_to_bytes-derived, no header/offset guesses) per-segment lengths, verifies each segment's Variant type and count, extracts only that row's scalar(s) via `_extract_scalar()`, and lets each decoded packed array fall out of scope
